note: A harness is described by its tier, never as generically 'supported'. No T2 harness has measured verdicts: no decision oracle exists, so verdicts would be evaluations from documented semantics, never interrogations. T2 is the ceiling until a vendor ships a deterministic offline evaluate-a-command entrypoint at a pinned version.
